auditSummary.method: Gallery metadata supplied by the parent chat from rendered DOM; bounded source/license checks of six author-linked public repositories. No plugin source copied or executed, no credentials used.
auditSummary.publicationGuideFinding: The official guide permits GitHub repositories that are either private or public. A published visible plugin is therefore not automatically open source, and public source access does not itself establish permission to reuse it.

architectureReference.licenseDeclaration: ISC in package metadata; separate license text not verified
architectureReference.coverageNotes: Official developer starter only. No one-to-one mapping to similarly named gallery examples was established. Not counted among the six mappings and not evidence that every gallery plugin has this license.

publicEditionNote: Public inventory preserves titles, source links and license evidence; gallery marketing descriptions are not republished.
